description: This Java class implements a Predicate used in conjunction with commons-collections filtering to find attributes with specific serialized values within customizable objects, typically within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: AttributeMatcherPredicate
classes.description: A predicate class to evaluate whether a customizable object has attributes matching specific serialized values.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the given object has attributes with values matching those in the provided map.

methods.name: AttributeMatcherPredicate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the predicate with a map of attribute types and their serialized string values.
